label: M1_mode1_classic_tdd_95rtp
_note: M1 mode 1 target v3 (2026-04-24) — TDD archetype + 95% RTP IGT variant.
Physical layout locked to IGT Triple Double Diamond / Hot Roll reel mapping (22 stops per reel, 3 independent reels). See reel_strips.json._archetype for source attribution.

Paytable (from M1.spec.json) is ~half of real TDD multipliers (Seven2=50x vs TDD Red 7=100x, pure 3-Triple Diamond=1000x vs TDD top-line 10000x). So TDD weights applied directly yield ~42.6% RTP. To hit 95% we need ~2.2x weight inflation on non-blank symbols — this is the IGT-style virtual-reel RTP variant mechanism (same physical reel, higher winning probability).
Modes 1/2/5/7 share the IDENTICAL physical layout (strips byte-identical). What varies is per-position virtual weights, simulating IGT 'RTP programs' / player luck. NOT per-mode pattern storytelling.

Removed from v2 target: per_reel_symbol_targets (was wrong — built on fabricated per-mode patterns inferred from historical dev sim data with no real-machine authority). v3 relies on RTP + hit_rate + bucket shape targets; per-reel density emerges from the PHYSICAL layout + weights (which IS grounded in TDD) rather than being separately constrained.

_design_constraints.archetype: IGT Triple Double Diamond (Hot Roll Wizard of Odds reverse-engineered)
